fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Forest/ WildLife Guard 2023 PMT Result 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Board (UPSSSC) has released the PMT Result on its official website for the Recruitment of Forest Guard Examination 2025. Applications for the UPSSSC Forest Guard, Wild Life Guard Recruitment 2023 were accepted from September 20, 2023, to October 10, 2023. The vacancy came in the year 2023 and it took almost three year one month to conduct the Medical examination for the prescribed posts. The Medical examination was held on 15 June 2026. Candidates who qualified PET/PMT examination can check their UPSSSC Forest/ Wild Life Guard 2023 PMT Result 2026 from the direct link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 September 2023
  • Last Date : 10 October 2023
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 October 2023
  • Correction Last Date : 17 October 2023
  • Eligibility Result Available : 07October 2024
  • Exam Date : 09 November 2025
  • Exam City Available : 30 October 2025
  • Admit Card Available : 06 November 2025
  • Answer Key : 10 November 2025
  • Result : 08 January 2026
  • PET & PMT Date : From 10 February 2026
  • PET & PMT Admit Card : 04 February 2026
  • PET & PMT Result : 30 April 2026
  • Medical Exam Date : 15 June 2026
  • Medical Admit Card : 09 June 2026
  • PMT Result : 03 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 25/-
  • PH (Dviyang) : Rs. 25/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
